selection_reasoning: These 4 tasks form a coherent multi-hop dependency chain centered around resource gathering and villager trading. First, the player must find coal_ore (a navigation/exploration task) which establishes awareness of the mining area. Then, the player mines yellow_concrete_powder (a mining task requiring the player to be in the resource area). The 'sell Stone' task requires the player to have stone in inventory (which can be pre-placed or gathered) and interact with a villager. Finally, 'trade for Iron Axe' requires emeralds obtained from selling stone to the villager, creating a clear economic dependency. The chain is: find coal_ore → mine yellow_concrete_powder (both in the mining area), sell Stone → trade for Iron Axe (economic chain), with find coal_ore also leading toward sell Stone since the mining area contains stone resources nearby.

edges.reason: Finding coal_ore guides player to the mining area where yellow_concrete_powder is also located nearby
Coal ore location reveals the stone/resource area where stone blocks can be collected for selling
Selling stone to the villager yields emeralds needed to purchase the Iron Axe in a subsequent trade

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The coal ore cluster is at spawn-relative coordinates [5-6, 0-1, 5-6]. Target is set to the center of the cluster at [5, 0, 5]. Player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they found it. Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the coal ore'.

Uses inventory_has because mining yellow_concrete_powder drops itself as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no yellow_concrete_powder, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. Yellow concrete powder can be mined with any tool or by hand and always drops itself.

Uses inventory_has to check for emeralds because selling stone to the mason villager (20 stone → 1 emerald) results in emeralds appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 64 stone and 0 emeralds (verified via /clear showing 0 emeralds removed), so having at least 1 emerald confirms a successful sale transaction.

Uses inventory_has because trading 3 emeralds for an iron axe with the mason villager results in the iron_axe appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with no iron_axe, so having at least 1 confirms the trade was completed successfully. The economy is balanced: 64 stone → 3 trades of 20 stone → 3 emeralds → 1 iron axe.

scene_description: A flat stone platform with three key areas: (1) A coal ore outcrop at ~5-6, ~0-1, ~5-6 with 6 blocks forming a visible cluster, (2) Yellow concrete powder blocks at ~8-9, ~0-1, ~3-4 forming a 2-tall bright yellow structure, (3) A small oak planks trading post at ~-6 to ~-3 in the negative direction containing a level-5 mason villager with two trades: 20 stone → 1 emerald, and 3 emeralds → 1 iron axe. Player starts with 64 stone and a wooden pickaxe.
task_text: Find the coal ore deposit, mine yellow concrete powder, then visit the mason villager to sell stone for emeralds and trade for an iron axe.
design_notes: Scene layout: Player spawns at center of 21x21 stone platform. Coal ore cluster is ~8 blocks to the front-right (positive X/Z). Yellow concrete powder is ~9 blocks to the right (positive X, moderate Z). Trading post is ~6 blocks behind-left (negative X/Z). Economy: 64 stone allows 3 trades of 20 stone each = 3 emeralds, exactly enough for the iron axe (costs 3 emeralds). Wooden pickaxe can mine both coal ore and yellow concrete powder. The 2-wide doorway allows easy villager access.
